title: Oops, Not Now: PEARL, a RAG-Based Support Agent for Gameplay and What Players Want from AI Help
abstract: arXiv:2609.13718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-powered gameplay support agents hold promise for game-based learning, yet grounding generative models in structured game data remains an open challenge. We present PEARL (Parallel Education Agent for Reflection and Learning), a dual-component Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that combines semantic knowledge retrieval with structural board-state matching to deliver contextualized scaffolding in Parallel, a puzzle game for learning parallel programming. PEARL operates on two input streams (natural language queries and board topology), retrieving both conceptual explanations of gameplay moves and peer-generated board states as evidence: capabilities unavailable to a standard Large Language Model (LLM) with game state access alone. In a qualitative evaluation (N=10) comparing PEARL against an existing community-based Open Player Model (OPM) visualization system, participants preferred the visualization system on perceived use

translated_title: 哎呀，不是现在：PEARL——一个基于RAG的游戏玩法支持代理，以及玩家对AI帮助的期望
translated_abstract: AI驱动的游戏玩法支持代理在基于游戏的学习中具有广阔前景，然而如何将生成式模型与结构化游戏数据相融合仍是一个开放性挑战。我们提出了PEARL（Parallel教育代理，用于反思与学习），这是一个双组件的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，它将语义知识检索与结构化棋盘状态匹配相结合，在Parallel（一款用于学习并行编程的益智游戏）中提供情境化的学习支架。PEARL基于两个输入流（自然语言查询和棋盘拓扑结构）运行，能够同时检索游戏操作的概念性解释和同伴生成的棋盘状态作为证据：这些能力是仅拥有游戏状态访问权限的标准大语言模型（LLM）所无法实现的。在一项定性评估（N=10）中，将PEARL与现有的基于社区的开源玩家模型（OPM）可视化系统进行比较，参与者在感知实用性方面更偏好可视化系统……
tldr: 该论文提出了PEARL，一个结合语义知识检索与棋盘状态匹配的双组件RAG系统，能为学习并行编程的益智游戏提供情境化学习支架，但用户研究发现玩家在某些方面仍更偏好现有社区可视化系统。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PEARL, a dual-component RAG system combining semantic knowledge retrieval with board-state matching to deliver contextualized scaffolding in a parallel programming puzzle game, though evaluation revealed players sometimes prefer existing community visualization systems.
